correctness.rationale: For all integers \(n,m\ge2\) and \(0<p<1\), the continuous-time generator yields the three explicitly displayed pair equations. Solving them by substitution gives \(U=sF/(2-sG)\), \(V=a(1+U)\), \(W=bU\). The denominator is strictly positive; a rational gap identity proves \(V>U>W>0\). Explicit first-order expansions give the \(m^{-2}\), \(m^{-1}\), and intermediate regimes when \(n/m\to\rho\in(0,\infty)\). This analytic proof is complemented by 512 passing exact-rational and full-state numerical assertions; finite tests are not treated as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Exact stationary spatial pair geometry in a natural heterogeneous clique-bouquet graph is a motivated observable beyond overall density. The direct hub neighbor is provably less correlated than two vertices in one petal, and two distinct \(m^{-2}\) and \(m^{-1}\) noise scales quantify when global versus local coherence disappears. These distinctions are not routine consequences of global density limits and have a clear network-clustering interpretation.
